title: Experience cannot emerge from the wholly non-experiential

statements.text: Experiential phenomena cannot emerge from wholly non-experiential phenomena. Whatever experience like ours emerges from must already be experiential in its fundamental nature, however primitively or strangely.

sources.quote: experiential phenomena cannot be emergent from wholly non-experiential phenomena
It must already be somehow experiential in its essential and fundamental nature, however primitively or strangely or (to us) incomprehensibly
